## What an app owes

A complete multi-screen app ships two files, `{项目名}-无限画布.html` and `{项目名}-可交互原型.html`, the project name and both suffixes in the user's language (English `-infinite-canvas`, `-interactive-prototype`), with shared content and flows consistent; changes to shared content sync both. A single screen, a component or a partial edit stays in its scope and adds no other file.

- **Prototype**: starts at the home screen and covers the core screens and flows with real state changes, 390×844 unless the user names a device.
- **Canvas**: read the [canvas method](../design-resources/skills/infinite-canvas/SKILL.md), then generate the project copy and follow what the script prints:

```text
node "<skill-dir>/scripts/adapt-canvas.mjs" "<workspace>/原型/项目名-无限画布.html"
```

Operate the home screen, every core screen and each core flow end to end. A prototype that claims to adapt is also audited at `1024,768`.
